messages.author: 99adaed568ab735c
messages.subject: error in multi-season detection history: 'records_too_late' not found
parts:
Hello!

I am trying to create a multi-season detection history and I keep getting this error:

Error in paste(length(records_too_late), "records were removed because they were before the first day in the camera operation matrix") : 
  object 'records_too_late' not found

the code:

DetHist_multi <- detectionHistory(recordTable      = df,
                                          camOp                  = camop_season,
                                          stationCol             = "ID",
                                          speciesCol             = "Species",
                                          species                = "Nasua nasua",
                                          occasionLength         = 10,
                                          day1                   = "survey",
                                          recordDateTimeCol      = "Date.Time",
                                          recordDateTimeFormat   = "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M",
                                          includeEffort          = TRUE,
                                          scaleEffort            = FALSE,
                                          unmarkedMultFrameInput = TRUE,
                                          writecsv = TRUE
        )
        


It doesn't seem to be nothing wrong with my  recordTable  and camop table, because when I run detectionHistory for each season (single season) it works just fine...

Thank you for any help.

Daniele

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: error in multi-season detection history: 'records_too_late' not found
parts:
Hi Daniele,
it was a bug in the detectionHistory function and should be fixed now in the github version. It only affected multi-season detection histories, when the record table date/time format is non-standard as in your case (standard being: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS). With the bugfix it should work for any date/time format.
Can you please reinstall from github and let me know if it works? 
Thank you,
Jürgen
